title.en: Audit and repair the complete multilingual vocabulary catalog
title.zh: 全量审计并修复多语言课程词库

purpose.en: Repair detectable data defects across all 48,000 course vocabulary rows and prevent the generation pipeline from reintroducing them.
purpose.zh: 修复全部 48,000 个课程词条中的可检测数据问题，并防止生成链路再次引入同类缺陷。

en: Repair 9,898 rows across all twelve target languages without changing vocabulary identity or learner progress keys.
Remove repeated glosses, malformed characters, leaked dictionary markup, unsafe labels, and unusable inflection definitions.
Lock reviewed high-frequency grammar meanings for nine non-English language catalogs.
zh: 覆盖全部十二种目标语言，共修复 9,898 条，同时不改变词条身份与用户学习进度键。
清除重复释义、乱码、词典标记泄漏、不安全标签和不可用的词形说明。
锁定九种非英语词库的已审高频语法词教学释义。

en: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced vocabulary data
Daily vocabulary and SmartCard answer choices
zh: 初级、中级和高级课程词库
每日词汇与智慧卡答案选项
管理员 Project 发布报告

en: Add twelve bounded forward-only migrations so production updates one language at a time.
Add a reproducible full-catalog audit and repair tool with fail-closed Chinese-gloss validation.
Reject learner-unready source senses during future catalog generation and regression-test the reviewed common-word gold set.
zh: 增加十二个有界前向迁移，生产数据库按语言依次更新。
增加可复现的全词库审计与修复工具，并对中文释义实行失败即停止校验。
未来生成词库时拒绝不适合学习的源词义，并用已审常用词金标准做回归测试。

en: A complete migration replay reports exactly 48,000 published rows and zero vocabulary-quality findings.
All 56 D1 migrations apply once, no-op on rerun, and preserve zero foreign-key violations.
The full production build and 310 automated tests pass, including the new catalog-quality contract.
zh: 完整迁移重放确认恰好 48,000 个已发布词条，词库质量问题计数为零。
全部 56 个 D1 迁移首次应用成功、再次运行无操作，外键违规为零。
完整生产构建及 310 项自动测试通过，包括新增的全词库质量契约。

en: Automated and reviewed high-frequency checks cannot claim that every rare homograph has received human lexicographer review; source and review-method attribution remains visible for that reason.
zh: 自动审计和高频词人工规则不能声称每个罕见同形词均由词典专家逐条审核，因此继续保留来源与审核方式标记。

en: This vocabulary-data correction is SmartLingo-only and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 本词汇数据修正仅适用于 SmartLingo，不改变其他站点。
